name: Renogy Inverter BLE Sensor
description: The `renogy_inverter_ble` sensor platform reads live data from a **Renogy inverter with built-in Bluetooth** over Bluetooth Low Energy — for example the **Renogy PUH 12V 3000W Pure Sine Wave Inverter** (with UPS transfer switch, SKU `RIV1230PU-126`) and other units in the `RNGRIU` family.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to poll the inverter. Defaults to `30s`.

config_entries.label: BLE Client ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [BLE Client](https://esphome.io/components/ble_client/) to read from.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
